newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle stake raised by Jacobs group.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle stake raised by Jacobs group.

text.p: A group led by Minneapolis investor Irwin Jacobs said Wednesday it raised its stake in Pinnacle Systems Inc to 525,800 common shares or 7.03 percent from 5.78 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 260,000 common shares between December 2 and January 31 at prices ranging from $10.149 to $12.344 per share.
The group bought its initial stake in the company on December 12 saying it bought the shares because it believed the shares were undervalued.
Pinnacle Systems, based in Santa Clara, Calif., is engaged in design, manufacture and marketing of high performance, cost effective video work stations.
